sinopsis.es: Después de que su suegro Makoto se fractura una pierna, el joven profesional Yuta viaja desde su casa en Tokio a un pueblo rural de Kyushu para cuidar del anciano y ayudar en su anticuado estudio fotográfico.
sinopsis.en: After his father-in-law Makoto fractures his leg, young professional Yuta travels from his home in Tokyo to a rural town in Kyushu to take care of the older man and help out in his old-fashioned photo studio.
